note: Flat faces of the Met fangding 49.135.2 (KIT.md § Flat faces). Points are [photo px in the ORIGINAL, then vessel mm x, y, z]. Model frame: legs on y = 0, vertical walls, long walls at z = ±65.5, short walls at x = ±81; décor fields: long frieze x ±75 × y 152.9–172.8, long mask x ±74.5 × y 103.1–148.9; short frieze ±58.8, short mask ±58 (same heights). Points are the outer corners of the two décor fields (their border fillets), read off the originals at 1:1 with a 10 px grid.

DP140736.note: long face near head-on, camera at mid-body height, ≈ 11 px/mm on the wall

DP140737.note: short face near head-on, ≈ 5.5 px/mm on the wall; which short face (±X) is not recorded, taken as +X
